basics.name: Lorenzo Graizzaro
basics.label: Software Developer | AI Engineer
basics.summary: Software Developer and AI Engineer. I build AI-powered products that solve concrete problems: filtering what's urgent out of hundreds of notifications, turning study notes into practice quizzes, detecting bank fraud with fewer false alarms. I took my project OpenRuleta to tech community events (KCD, Ekoparty, Data Saturday LATAM), where I presented and ran it live with hundreds of attendees. I also attend Nerdearla and talks by AWS, OpenAI Codex, and Microsoft (AI and GitHub Copilot), and take part in hackathons. As a teaching assistant at UNSAM I support student teams in their architecture decisions. I work full-stack (TypeScript and Python) with serverless deployment on AWS.

work.name: Universidad Nacional de San Martín
work.summary: Teaching assistant for Algorithms 3 and PHM: I support teams of advanced students building complete applications with solid software engineering practices.
highlights: Help each team choose the right database for its problem (relational, document, or cache) and justify the decision
Guide students to keep their projects decoupled and maintainable, ready to grow toward microservices
Turn complex technical concepts into simple explanations adapted to each student's level

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Custom application development for clients on freelance platforms, alongside my own products that embed AI into the workflow.
highlights: Deliver custom solutions where AI is part of the process, not an add-on: it automates repetitive tasks and simplifies the user's work
Prioritize secure, scalable solutions with controlled infrastructure costs (serverless on AWS)
Take my own products from idea to real use: OpenRuleta ran live at events with hundreds of people

work.name: Fabric SRL
work.summary: Administrative and operational processes: invoicing, payments, taxes, payroll, inventory control, and information management across several digital systems.
highlights: Built operational reports with direct SQL queries on the production database, keeping business data at hand for decision-making
Managed day-to-day accounting with Xubio (checks, transfers, and inventory), ensuring data accuracy

work.name: Banco de la Nación Argentina
work.summary: Customer support over remote channels, prioritizing accuracy and data security.
highlights: Resolved high-volume queries with internal systems, explaining banking processes to non-technical customers
Handled sensitive customer information following strict security procedures

skills.name: Cloud
keywords: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, DynamoDB, S3, SQS, Cognito, Polly, Lightsail, AWS SAM)

projects.name: Prioria
projects.description: Android app that cuts notification noise: an AI agent decides which ones matter and reads them out loud.
highlights: Solves notification overload: an AI agent detects what's urgent and reads it aloud, so users don't need to check their phone
Learns from every user response (thumbs up/down and conversation with the agent) to prioritize better over time
100% serverless infrastructure: near-zero cost when idle and scales on its own as demand grows
keywords: AWS serverless (Lambda, Bedrock, DynamoDB, Cognito, SQS, Polly, SAM)

projects.name: StudyQuest
projects.description: Collaborative study platform that turns notes into AI-generated quizzes and lets students compete in real time.
highlights: Turns notes and PDFs into playable quizzes in minutes, saving the manual work of building practice material
Real-time group study: matchmaking, rooms, and chat to practice with other students
Swappable AI provider to pick the model per user plan and keep costs under control
Every change is specified before it is coded (Spec-Driven Development), reducing rework

projects.name: OpenRuleta
projects.description: Frictionless event raffles: attendees sign up from their phones and the operator draws winners on the big screen.
highlights: Presented and run live at KCD, Ekoparty, and Data Saturday LATAM Argentina 2026 (~300 concurrent sign-ups from phones at the latter)
Zero infrastructure cost: everything runs on Supabase's free tier
Secure by design: the public form can only register entries and never read other participants' data

projects.name: FraudDetector
projects.description: Bank fraud detection over 100k+ transactions using a 3-model ML consensus and an interactive dashboard.
highlights: Cuts false alarms by ~35% versus a single model: a customer is flagged only when at least 2 of 3 models agree
40–150 ms responses per analysis, fast enough to review cases on the spot
Visual dashboard so a non-technical analyst can understand why a customer is risky

projects.name: BookLibre
projects.description: Full-stack book reservation and rental system, group academic project (UNSAM).
highlights: Teamwork with a pull-request and code-review flow, as in a professional team
Each kind of data in the database that suits it best (relational, document, and cache) so the app responds fast
Secure sessions between frontend and backend hosted on different domains
